1 想治我个越矩的罪名，没门
前一部写到正三品盐运使司的方敬澜之幺女如情，在经历了各种风波后，总算与五品上林菀监正的向家订下婚约，后来为躲避宫中选秀，这才到大同“避难”，住进了二哥方知义的御赐镇国将军府邸。知义对这个妹子还是很疼爱的，如情在将军府过得如鱼似水，但也有不如意的时候，比方说，知义的通房挽雪，时常用小白花形像与如情添堵。而再来就是一直看她不顺眼总想找她麻烦的靖王李骁也在大同，有这两樽瘟神，使得如情不得不小心又谨慎地对付着……而这个时候，参加代王府的筵席上，又遇上了好些堵心的事……
接下来，请接着《庶女当道》的第二部
虽然已立了春，并早已停了雪，但初八这天，大同的街头却是夹杂着冰凉的冷风，拂过千家万户。
虽然在大同没什么亲人，但镇国将军手握重兵，在民间自有威望，知义仍是狠受了几回邀请。身为知义唯一的家眷，如情也跟着去了。
代王妃是个五十上下的中年贵妇，穿着厚厚的姜黄色遍透宝相花富贵吉实云纹领口袖口镶貂毛对襟袄，头上戴着朝阳五凤大挂朱叉，团头髻上足足各十二支纯金打造的簪子，一支通体碧亮的白玉镶金丝偏凤钗压在鬓边，整身看起来珠光宝气，华丽非凡。
如情磕了头后，忍不住多看了代王妃，这么多东西压在头顶上，居然脖子还没在被压断，太佩服了。不过瞧着代王妃那厚厚妆容都掩不住的老态与生姜丝，如情暗付：看来代王妃失宠的传言应该是真的了。
不过这些都不关她的事，垫着手头厚厚的用金丝线绣的荷包，上头还镶了个指甲大的珠子，光这个荷包就能值些钱了。
代王妃打赏了如情，又把她拉在身前，仔细瞧了瞧，眼里满是赞赏，“不愧为镇国将军的妹子，镇军将军气宇轩昂，人中龙凤，妹子也是绝色出尘，珠儿，你快过来瞧瞧，平时候自恃美貌，自诩为大同第一美人，如今可好了，这镇国将军的妹子，无论气质还是颜色，可不比你差哦。”
那个叫珠儿的少女一身气派的土黄色翡翠撒花锦绫袄及洋绉裙，头戴攒金丝羊指玉赤金凤钗，闻言忍不住打量了这个传说中英挺不凡气纳百川的镇国将军的妹子，只见眼前的少女穿着松花色掐金丝对襟袄子，领口腰背及袖口处皆镶着白色动物毛，衬得一张玉一样的脸色更是明艳动人。这位叫珠儿的少女是代王府的嫡出郡主，近乎挑剔地上下打量了如情，忽然冷声道：“方姑娘确实姿色非凡，本郡主自愧不如。不过，我听说，方姑娘只是庶出的吧，镇国将军也只是从二品的官位，就可以穿貂毛了？按我朝规定，非一二品朝庭大员或功勋带爵方可穿貂毛，方姑娘，你这可是越矩哦？”
郡主话一出口，在场诸人脸色骤变，纷纷盯着如晴身上的白色镶毛边，一些小心谨慎之人眼里闪过狐疑，却只缄言不语。但也有人直接惊讶嚷了出来，“郡主这么一说，我倒想起来了。按我朝矩定，非一二品大官以上不得穿戴貂毛等名贵之物，方姑娘，你这可是越矩了呀！”
如情望着说话之人，此人与代王妃有几分相似，年纪稍轻些，身后立着个面目娇好下巴瘦削的嫩芽色夹花褙子的少女，也笑盈盈地上下打量如情，掩唇笑道：“若真如此，那，若让御史知道了，可不得了哦。轻则受申斥并打入大理寺，重则还抄家灭族，不过，这越矩之罪，可大可小。单要看本地御史大人和王妃娘娘的心情而定了。”
一个妇人对如情和气笑道：“方姑娘年纪幼小，估计也不知这些规矩的，镇国将军又是个大老粗，如何知道这里头的名堂？我看还是不要太动真格了，方姑娘，黄姑娘说得对，你这事儿，可大可小，你就向王妃娘娘陪个不是，再恳请黄夫人多多宽照一二，这岂不大事化小，小事化无？”
在场的贵妇也有与知义交好的，纷纷点头七嘴八舌让如晴服个软，恳求代王妃及黄夫人，让她们不予追究，这事儿就完了。
渐渐地，如情总算明白了这位黄氏母女的身份，黄夫人的夫婿是节制山西政事的巡抚，而黄家闺女与山西御史大夫之子订下婚约，如果如情确实穿衣愈制，首先便要先经过御史大夫及巡扶这一关，再来是代王妃这一关。
如果御史大夫与代王妃不予追究，那么便不会上凑朝庭，否则，此事若上凑了朝庭，由司礼监查下来，不但连累整个方家，说不定还会抄家灭族。
而知义此次被授之把柄，日后岂不处处被代王府及巡抚御史等人节制？
如晴在山西呆了足足一年了，如何不知代王府一直想拉笼自家兄长，但兄长却鄙夷代王一家子男的好色贪ying，女的骄奢跋扈，再来上一代代王爷因“骄奢淫逸、穷凶恶极、私设刑狱、强占民田”等数罪并发，至今被圈禁至京中皇庄里，皇帝震怒之下，早已削去了代王府节制山西军政的权利，代王府不甘心权势旁落，势必打着山西地界各个手握重权的文武百官的主意。
而在政事上，山西巡抚大人与代王爷乃连襟，关系非同一般，至于知义，身为山西地界除了总督外，就数他的官位最高，手握重兵，并且在民间武将里极有威望，代王府无法拉笼，只得舍弃并打压。
如今，如果因如情一件衣裳而爱制于人，这对知义来说，将是个灭顶的打击，对代王府来说，则是个控制知义最佳妙法。

理通了这里头的利害后，如情并不惊慌，只是望着老王妃及郡主道：“如情区区一个三品官的庶女，就算平时不识几个字，但父兄时常告诫我有关我朝的津法规定，我朝的律法如情至今还背不齐，但也深知，一二品大员以下家眷，不得穿貂皮、绣龙凤纹式样的头面首饰等名贵之物。王妃娘娘和郡主身份高贵，出身不凡，如何不识得貂毛么？居然还把狐狸毛认作是貂毛，郡主，您这个玩笑未免也太大了点。”说到最后，如情双眸已放冷茫，在心里暗骂：你丫的，就算姑娘我穿了貂毛你又耐我何？虽然一二品以下官员家眷是不得穿貂毛这类越制之物，但知义可是皇帝亲授的镇国将军，并赐了一件立蟒袍，有蟒袍在身，地位可直逼三公之例，区区镶有貂毛的衣裳又算得啥？
你丫的仗着郡主身份就敢跑来呛身，说你是胸大无脑呢，还是安逸日子过久了，不晓得利害了。
如情话一出口，在场诸人面色一变，有些性子急的还上前仔细打量如晴袖口的毛，连声道：“还真看不出来是狐狸毛，可确实不是貂毛，郡主，您平时候眼光一向独到，怎么这次却……”
另一人立马接口，“定是郡主和方姑娘开个玩笑罢了。”
其他人也一并附和着，但想着刚才代王妃及黄夫人母女的对话，心里却有了其他的想法，不过心里却暗自不屑着，你代王府想拉笼镇国将军，世人皆知，但也得找个隐避的手段吧？郡主这样的小把戏也敢拿出手？不知该称代王府确实是图穷匕现，还是狗急跳墙。

content_en:
1 If you want to punish me with a crime that exceeds the rules, there is no way.
In the previous part, it was written that Ruqing, the youngest daughter of Fang Jinglan, who was in the third-grade Salt Transport Department, after experiencing various turmoils, finally entered into an engagement with the Xiang family, who was in charge of Lin Wan, the fifth-grade supervisor. Later, in order to avoid the palace draft, she went to Datong to "take refuge" and lived in the Yuci Zhenguo General's mansion owned by her second brother Fang Zhiyi. Zhiyi still loved this girl very much. Ruqing lived like a fish in the general's mansion, but there were times when things went wrong. For example, Zhiyi's wife often used the image of a small white flower to get in Ruqing's way. And then, Prince Jing Li Xiao, who always disliked her and always wanted to cause trouble for her, was also in Datong. With these two bottles of plague, Ruqing had to deal with them cautiously... At this time, while attending the banquet at Prince Dai's Mansion, she encountered a lot of troublesome things...
Next, please continue with the second part of "The Concubine"
Although spring has begun and the snow has stopped long ago, on the eighth day of the Lunar New Year, the streets of Datong are filled with icy cold wind, blowing through thousands of homes.
Although he didn't have any relatives in Datong, the Zhenguo general held a heavy army and had great prestige among the people. Zhiyi still accepted several invitations. As Zhiyi's only family member, Ruqing also went with him.
Princess Dai is a middle-aged lady in her fifties. She wears a thick ginger-yellow coat with rich and auspicious moire patterns at the neck and cuffs inlaid with mink fur. She wears a Chaoyang Five Phoenix hanging on her head and a large red fork on her head. There are twelve hairpins made of pure gold on her bun. A bright white jade inlaid with gold wire partial phoenix hairpin is pressed on her temples. The whole body looks jeweled and gorgeous.
After Ruqing kowtowed, she couldn't help but look at Princess Dai. With so many things pressing on her head, her neck was not broken yet. I was so impressed. However, looking at Princess Dai's old age and ginger silk hair that could not be concealed by thick makeup, Ru Qing secretly thought: It seems that the rumors that Princess Dai has fallen out of favor are true.
But these were none of her business. She had a thick purse embroidered with gold thread on hand, with a nail-sized bead on it. This purse alone was worth some money.
Princess Dai rewarded Ruqing, then pulled her in front of her, took a closer look, her eyes were full of admiration, "She is worthy of being the daughter of the General of the Zhenguo. The General of the Zhenjun is majestic and impressive, and the girl is also stunningly beautiful. Zhu'er, come and have a look. She usually prides herself on her beauty and calls herself the most beautiful woman in Datong. Now she is so good. The girl of the General of the Zhenguo is no worse than you in terms of temperament and color."
The girl named Pearl was dressed in an elegant earth-yellow emerald flowered brocade jacket and crepe skirt. She was wearing a golden phoenix hairpin with sheep's fingers and jade on her head. After hearing this, she couldn't help but look at this legendary figure. The girl in front of me was the girl of General Zhen Guo. I saw the girl in front of me wearing a pine flower-colored gold-plated double-breasted jacket. The collar, waist, back and cuffs were trimmed with white animal hair, which made her jade-like face even more bright and moving. The girl named Zhu'er was the daughter-in-law of the Prince of Dai. She looked at Ruqing up and down with an almost critical look, and suddenly said in a cold voice: "Miss Fang is indeed extraordinary in beauty, and I, the princess, am ashamed of herself. However, I heard that Miss Fang is only a concubine, right? The general of the country can only wear mink fur from a second-rank official position? According to the regulations of our court, only first- and second-rank court officials or meritorious nobles can wear mink fur. Miss Fang, are you going out of bounds?"
As soon as the princess spoke, the expressions of everyone present suddenly changed, and they all stared at the white fur trim on Ruqing's body. Suspicion flashed in the eyes of some cautious people, but they remained silent. But some people were surprised and shouted out, "I remembered what the princess said. According to the rules of my court, no one above the first or second rank is allowed to wear mink fur or other precious things. Miss Fang, you are going beyond the rules!"
Ruqing looked at the person who was speaking. This person was somewhat similar to Princess Dai. She was a little younger. Behind her stood a girl with a delicate face and a thin chin, a bud-colored girl with a flowered bra. She also looked at Ruqing up and down with a smile, covering her lips and smiling.He said: "If this is really the case, then it would be terrible if the censor knew about it. At the least, he would be reprimanded and imprisoned in Dali Temple, or at the worst, his family would be confiscated and his family exterminated. However, this crime of violating the rules can be serious or small. It just depends on the mood of the local censor and the princess."
A woman smiled kindly at Ruqing and said: "Miss Fang is young and probably doesn't know these rules. The general of Zhenguo is a big boss. How do you know the reputation here? I think it's better not to take it too seriously. Miss Fang, Miss Huang is right. This matter of yours is big or small. Just tell the princess and ask Mrs. Huang to be more lenient. Wouldn't this mean that big things will be reduced to trivial matters and trivial matters will be reduced to nothing?"
The ladies present were also friends with Zhiyi, and they all nodded and talked to convince Ruqing. They begged Princess Dai and Madam Huang to let them not pursue the matter and the matter would be over.
Gradually, Ruqing finally understood the identity of the Huang mother and daughter. Mrs. Huang's husband was the governor who controlled the political affairs of Shanxi, and the daughter of the Huang family was engaged to the son of the Shanxi Yushi doctor. If Ruqing really dressed up and became more and more fashionable, she would first have to go through the test of the Yushi doctor and Xunfu, and then the step of acting as a princess.
If the imperial censor and the concubine did not pursue the matter, they would not go to the court. Otherwise, if the matter went to the court and was investigated by the Secretary of Ceremony, it would not only implicate the entire Fang family, but might also lead to the confiscation of the family and the annihilation of the family.
And if Zhiyi is given the handle this time, won't he be controlled by the Dai Wangfu, the governor and the censor and others in the future?
Ruqing has been staying in Shanxi for a full year. She didn't know that Prince Dai's palace always wanted to seize her brother, but his brother despised Dai Wang's family because the men were lustful and greedy, and the women were arrogant and domineering. In addition, the previous generations of princes were accused of being "extremely extravagant, lewd, vicious, and setting up private prisons". He was convicted of several crimes, including "grabbing and seizing people's land" and was imprisoned in the imperial palace in the capital. In anger, the emperor had already cut off the power of the Dai Wangfu to control Shanxi's military government. The Daiwangfu was unwilling to lose power and was bound to take advantage of the powerful civil and military officials in Shanxi.
In terms of political affairs, the governor of Shanxi and Prince Dai were brothers-in-law, and their relationship was extraordinary. As for Zhiyi, apart from the governor of Shanxi, he had the highest official position, commanded a large number of troops, and was extremely prestigious among the civilian generals. Prince Dai's palace could not control him, so he had to abandon and suppress him.
Now, if love controls others because of a piece of clothing like love, this will be a devastating blow to Zhiyi, and for Dai Wangfu, it will be the best way to control Zhiyi.
After understanding the stakes here, Ruqing did not panic. She just looked at the old princess and the princess and said: "Ruqing is a concubine of a third-grade official. Even if she doesn't know a few words, my father and brother often warn me about the laws and regulations of our dynasty. Ruqing still doesn't memorize all the laws of our dynasty. But I also know that the family members of first- and second-grade officials and below are not allowed to wear mink or embroider dragons." The princess and the princess have noble status and extraordinary backgrounds, so they still think that fox fur is mink fur. Princess, your joke is too big." At the end of the sentence, Ruqing's eyes became cold and she cursed in her heart: Damn it, even if I wear mink fur, how can you stand up to me? Although the family members of officials below the first or second rank were not allowed to wear mink fur or other over-the-top items, Zhiyi was a general appointed by the emperor himself, and was given a standing python robe. With the python robe on him, his status could be as high as that of the three princes. What does it mean to just wear mink fur clothes?
You dare to come and choke me just because you are the princess, saying that you are big-hearted and have no brains, or that you have lived a comfortable life for too long and don't know what is good or bad.
As soon as Ruqing's words came out, the expressions of everyone present changed. Some impatient ones even stepped forward to carefully examine the fur on Ruqing's sleeves, saying repeatedly: "I really can't tell that it's fox fur, but it's definitely not mink fur. Princess, you usually have a unique vision, but why do you do this this time..."
Another person immediately responded, "It must beThe princess and Miss Fang were just joking. "
Others also agreed, but thinking about the conversation between Princess Dai and Madam Huang's mother and daughter, they had other thoughts in their minds. However, they secretly disdained it. It is known to the world that you, on behalf of the prince, want to seduce the general of the country, but you have to find a way to hide it, right? The princess dares to pull off such a little trick? I don’t know if I should call Dai Wang’s Mansion a real one, or a desperate act.
